description: This file defines Lithuanian (lt-LT) culture information for the Date.js library, including locale-specific date and time formats, month and day names, regex patterns, and helper functions for date parsing and formatting.

methods.name: $D.prototype.clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time part of the date to midnight.

methods.name: $D.prototype.setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date's time to the current system time.

methods.name: $D.today
methods.description: Returns a new Date object representing today with time cleared.

methods.name: $D.equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.
